relationships.evidence_quote: CBD accelerates oral ulcer healing by inhibiting CMPK2-mediated NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis

key_findings: CBD accelerates oral ulcer healing and relieves pain by inhibiting CMPK2-mediated NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis, mostly via PPARγ.
